sloka: उवाच च ततो रामस्तम् गार्ग्यमभिसान्त्वयन् ।मन्युर्न खलु कर्तव्यः परिहासो ह्ययम् मम ॥२-३२-३९॥
transliteration: uvāca ca tato rāmastam gārgyamabhisāntvayan ।manyurna khalu kartavyaḥ parihāso hyayam mama ॥2-32-39॥

translations.english: The virtuous Rama embraced Trijata, and despatched all the cattle extending up to the bank of Sarayu to his hermitage.
